Clean rebuild marker: v1.1.0 (versionCode 3). Standalone date-and-time reminders on the Jalali calendar (once, every N minutes during a day, daily, weekly, Jalali monthly/yearly, end date), Reminders tab with health check and test notification, calendar integration, boot catch-up of missed rings. Fix: reminder notifications were never posted on Android 8-12 (POST_NOTIFICATIONS check), exact alarms on Android 14+ via USE_EXACT_ALARM. Unit tests run before the release build. Release workflow publishes 3 APKs (universal, arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a) to GitHub Releases named after versionName.
